name: Medicare — 846 no limited-liability record on file: clear both checks, then request a COB update
description: Seven guided steps: identify the PX_846 hard edit and check the event hierarchy, read the member's Product in Group Additional Information to rule out a COVA Medicare Supplement policy, search Limited Liability and find no MED LL record on file for the date of service, open Request Claim Review from the Action menu, select Request COB Update, enter the review details in Comments and submit the request, and submit the claim without a decision.

steps.name: Identify the 846 hard edit and check the event hierarchy
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab. The application displays every edit the claim hit, and PX_846 is the current event requiring review, flagged with an error indication as a Hard Edit. Note what 846 actually is: a Medicare Limited Liability (LL) record missing for the date of service — not a line-level COB amount to correct. Then read down the All Edits list in hierarchy order to determine whether any event must be resolved before 846. If others are present, resolve those first in hierarchy order; if none is, carry on. Here 846 is the only event on the claim, so nothing stands ahead of it and you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is clicked while this step is active. It is the tab the workspace opens on, so the click is a deliberate one.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the All Edits list shows PX_846 marked (Active) with its Severity beside it. Check whether any other event is listed before deciding to move on.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the 846 hard edit and check the event hierarchy

steps.name: Verify the policy is not COVA Medicare Supplement
steps.description: Go to the Search tab, Member sub-tab, and open the Group Additional Information section. Read the Product field to establish what policy this member holds, because a Commonwealth of Virginia (COVA) Medicare Supplement policy follows an entirely different set of guidelines and would not be routed the way this claim is. If the policy indicates COVA Medicare Supplement, follow the alternate guidelines instead; if it does not, carry on. Here the Product reads OPENACCPOS, which does not indicate COVA Medicare Supplement, so you proceed. Read the field rather than inferring from the member's state.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Group Additional Information section is opened on Search → Member while this step is active. Opening Group Contract Information does not complete it, and the section will not open before this step is active.
steps.hint: Search → Member. Below the member's General Information, open the Group Information panel's 'Group Additional Information' section and read Product.
steps.checklistItem: Verify the policy is not COVA Medicare Supplement

steps.name: Confirm no MED LL record is on file for the DOS
steps.description: Go to the Search tab, Limited Liability sub-tab, and review the MED LL records for the claim's Date of Service. Determine whether a MED LL record is on file for that DOS. If one is, carry on processing the claim under the standard guidelines — there is nothing to route. If none is, the routing guidelines apply and the claim goes to the team that owns the record. Here the Limited Liability Results section shows its column headings — Type, Effective date, End date, Order of benefits and Description — with no record beneath them, confirming no MED LL record is on file, so you route the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Limited Liability sub-tab is opened while this step is active. The sub-tab has no record to open and no action to dispatch, so the visit is the trigger.
steps.hint: Search → Limited Liability. Look under 'Limited Liability Results': the column headings are there, but check whether any record is listed beneath them.
steps.checklistItem: Confirm no MED LL record is on file for the DOS

steps.name: Open the Request Claim Review action
steps.description: Both checks are clear, so the routing guidelines apply: the missing MED LL record belongs to the E-COB team, and 846 resolves itself once they add it. Go to the claim summary at the top of the workspace, open the Action menu and select Request Claim Review. A dialog appears with the message "Please select the action to perform".
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Request Claim Review is chosen from the Action menu while this step is active, which opens the dialog. Chosen earlier, the dialog stays closed.
steps.hint: The Action menu is on the claim summary bar. Choose 'Request Claim Review'.
steps.checklistItem: Open the Request Claim Review action

steps.name: Select Request COB Update
steps.description: In the "Please select the action to perform" dropdown, select Request COB Update. The dialog then expands to show the COB update options.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when claimReview.action is Request COB Update. Selecting any other option leaves the step open and reveals nothing.
steps.hint: Open the dropdown in the Request Claim Review dialog and choose the option that asks COB to update the record.

steps.name: Submit the COB update request
steps.description: Enter the review details in the Comments box, for example "Please update LL records" — the comment is what tells the E-COB team which record is missing and what is needed — then click the Submit button in the dialog. A comment must be present in the Comments box for the submission to be accepted. The claim is thereby routed for the missing MED LL record to be added.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the dialog Submit is pressed with Request COB Update selected and a non-blank comment entered. Otherwise the press is refused and the Submit status says what is missing.
steps.hint: Type the review details into Comments, then click 'Submit' at the bottom of the Request Claim Review dialog. If nothing happens, check that Comments is not empty.

steps.name: Submit without a decision
steps.description: Close the Request Claim Review dialog, then click Submit on the claim summary without selecting a decision. Do not choose Pay or Deny: the claim is being routed for the missing MED LL record rather than adjudicated, and the 846 event resolves automatically once the record is added.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the claim is submitted with no decision selected. Submitting Pay or Deny does not complete it.
steps.hint: Leave the decision empty — do not pick Pay or Deny — and click Submit on the claim summary bar.
